metadata.directive: HINAA UI and Runtime Architecture Verification

components.name: AppShell
components.limitations: Desktop-centric CSS grid layout; mobile breakpoint relies on MobileNavigation fallback.

components.name: TopBarV6
components.limitations: Defines 6 WorkspaceModes but some mode switches only change viewport tabs rather than unmounting heavy 3D canvases.

components.name: NavigationRail
components.limitations: TypeScript type declares 17 sections, but UI renders only 7 physical navigation buttons with 10 mapped aliases.

components.name: DynamicIslandCompanion
components.limitations: Heavy animation loops when expanded; depends on mock telemetry when real websocket audio is disconnected.

components.name: WorkMode
components.limitations: Primary default view. Hides administrative dashboards (Durable Tasks, Approvals Queue, Capabilities Registry) which reside in OperateMode.

components.name: OperateMode
components.limitations: Renders 83 registered capabilities and approval queues. Requires user to click 'Dashboard' to view.

components.name: ShowroomMode
components.limitations: Full-screen 3D runway studio. Relies on WebGL context; crashes in headless test runners unless VRMAvatar is mocked.

components.name: VRMAvatar
components.limitations: Active default model (/models/model_6164.vrm) is VRM 0.x with only 14 standard blendshapes (5 visemes + 3 blinks + 5 emotions + Neutral). 52 PerfectSync ARKit blendshapes are NOT present on active model, only present on hinaa-perfectsync.vrm.

components.name: HinaaUIController
components.limitations: Dispatches actuation actions (switch_mode, toggle_drawer, etc.), but lacks sequence numbers, runId isolation, deduplication, and selector allowlisting, posing an injection risk if arbitrary text is passed.

components.name: AssistantTurnPlanContract
components.limitations: displayText capped at 150,000 chars; spokenText capped at 8,000 chars. Salvage path recovers truncated inputs.

components.name: AssistantTurnPlanBackend
components.limitations: Strict extra='forbid' validation. Non-JSON conversational text converted via build_plan_from_text.

components.name: ToolRegistry
components.limitations: 83 tools registered; 16 local-effect tools strictly constrained to loopback/local operator mode. Not all 83 tools are live-executed in production without third-party API credentials (e.g. Freepik, You.com).

components.name: ToolPolicyEngine
components.limitations: Tier 2, 3, 4 strictly require confirmed=True and approvalSource='user'. Remote tunnel requests are blocked from executing local effect tools.

components.name: SwarmOrchestrator
components.limitations: Runs sequentially or parallel across 5 simulated persona roles in isolated Git worktrees. Requires local git CLI installed.

components.name: PTYSessionManager
components.limitations: Thread-based non-blocking pipes on Windows; emulated PTY rather than native Linux pty/forkpty.

components.name: VisionPTYBridge
components.limitations: Claimed in architectural narrative. Vision perception and PTY management exist as separate modules; no integrated VisionPTYBridge component exists in the repository.

components.name: MemoryManagerV2
components.limitations: In-memory partitions with SQLite persistence. Uses explicit rule-based supersession and temporal validity; no autonomous neurobiological sleep consolidation or unguided general truth resolution.

components.name: ProviderFallbackCascade
components.limitations: Initial connection retries and status code mappings (429, 500, timeout) are implemented. Mid-stream failover cannot transparently resume without replaying context. '100% uptime' claim is revoked.
